metadata.title: Why Quantum Energy Levels Aren't Evenly Spaced
metadata.thing: a stack of standing waves (1,2,3,4 half-waves) with energy rungs rising as n-squared
metadata.color_notes: Standing waves + energy rungs = accent Warm Slate #5A5653. Energy axis, walls, value numbers = ink #1a1a1a. The widening-gap braces and the closing 'n squared' emphasis = red #C0392B.

beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a small friendly bear, full body, standing, looking up with curiosity]

beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: You'd expect a ladder of energy rungs to be evenly spaced, like any normal ladder.
beats.tts_normalized_text: You'd expect a ladder of energy rungs to be evenly spaced, like any normal ladder.
beats.new_visual_element: a person climbing an evenly-spaced ladder
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person climbing a ladder with evenly spaced rungs]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person partway up an evenly spaced ladder]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and an evenly spaced ladder draw in; the person climbs steadily; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: But a quantum box's rungs fan apart the higher you climb.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But a quantum box's rungs fan apart the higher you climb.
beats.new_visual_element: the person on a ladder whose rungs widen toward the top
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person on a ladder whose rungs get farther apart toward the top]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person straining to reach a far-apart upper rung]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the ladder draws in with rungs spaced wider and wider toward the top; the person strains to reach the next one; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: On the left, a wave in a box; on the right, its energy on a ladder.
beats.tts_normalized_text: On the left, a wave in a box; on the right, its energy on a ladder.
beats.new_visual_element: a box (left) and an energy axis (right)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a box on the left and a vertical energy axis on the right

beats.narration_text: The lowest state fits one half-wave, and its energy is one rung up.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The lowest state fits one half-wave, and its energy is one rung up.
beats.new_visual_element: n=1 wave (one hump) + energy rung at 1
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw the n=1 standing wave (one hump) in the box and a rung at energy 1 on the axis

beats.narration_text: Add a second half-wave and the energy doesn't double — it quadruples, to four.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Add a second half-wave and the energy doesn't double — it quadruples, to four.
beats.new_visual_element: n=2 wave (two humps) + energy rung at 4
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: transform the wave to n=2 (two humps) and add a rung at energy 4, much higher than 1

beats.narration_text: Three half-waves land at nine; four land at sixteen.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Three half-waves land at nine; four land at sixteen.
beats.new_visual_element: n=3 then n=4 waves + rungs at 9 and 16
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: step the wave to n=3 then n=4, adding rungs at 9 and 16; the box wave gets more humps

beats.narration_text: So the rungs sit at one, four, nine, sixteen — and the gaps keep widening.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So the rungs sit at one, four, nine, sixteen — and the gaps keep widening.
beats.new_visual_element: the widening gaps (3, 5, 7) marked between rungs
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: mark the gaps between consecutive rungs (3, 5, 7) showing they grow

beats.narration_text: The reason: each step packs in one more half-wave, so the wavelength shrinks.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The reason: each step packs in one more half-wave, so the wavelength shrinks.
beats.new_visual_element: highlight that the box wave's wavelength shrinks with each step
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: highlight the shrinking wavelength in the box as n grows (shorter and shorter humps)

beats.narration_text: And energy depends on the square of how many waves fit, so doubling them quadruples it.
beats.tts_normalized_text: And energy depends on the square of how many waves fit, so doubling them quadruples it.
beats.new_visual_element: the n vs n-squared relationship called out
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: call out 'energy is proportional to (number of waves) squared' linking the count to the rung height

beats.narration_text: That's why the rungs fan apart instead of marching up in even steps.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That's why the rungs fan apart instead of marching up in even steps.
beats.new_visual_element: red label 'energy grows as n squared'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle the ladder and write a red label 'energy grows as n squared'; clean close
